rationale: Crawfish Solar Holdings 2, LLC is the narrowest proved manager-level portfolio boundary. JERA closed its 100% acquisition on August 2, 2024 and reduced its interest to 50% on July 30, 2025 through a sale to SG US Aggregator LLC. Current JERA evidence continues to show JERA Nex and Schroders Greencoat at 50% each. Happy and Oxbow are underlying operating assets and must not be counted again as separate Schroders PortCos.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical Crawfish Solar Holdings 2, LLC portfolio covering Happy and Oxbow.
Record JERA Nex Americas LLC as 100% owner from August 2, 2024 and 50% current owner from July 30, 2025.
Record SG US Aggregator LLC, an affiliate managed by Schroders Greencoat, as the other 50% current owner from July 30, 2025.
Record the Lightsource bp selling affiliate as former owner ending August 2, 2024 while retaining Lightsource bp only as the asset-management and O&M provider.
Keep Happy Solar 1, LLC, Oxbow Solar Farm 1, LLC and the intervening Crawfish entities within the portfolio boundary rather than creating additional PortCos.
